expiry_rule: Every listing expires 30 days after the date it was verified. A listing past its expiry is shown as stale, never silently.

listings.offer: Hot meals and a food pantry with fresh produce, dry goods, meat, and dairy items. Breakfast and lunch are served on the days listed, and pantry bags of groceries can be picked up in the pantry hours listed.
listings.when: Breakfast 9:30 a.m. to 10:30 a.m. on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. Lunch 2 p.m. to 3 p.m. on Tuesday and Thursday. Food Pantry open Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 10 a.m. to 12 p.m. and 1 p.m. to 3 p.m.

listings.offer: Food assistance for individuals and families in need. The pantry has fresh produce, dairy, and non perishable food, and an open door fridge and pantry where people can take what they need and leave what they can.
listings.when: The page describes the pantry as self service and 24/7.
listings.where: The provider page does not state a street address.

listings.offer: Breakfast and lunch served daily. The center also runs a food pantry where guests select groceries, but the page does not publish pantry shopping hours, so this listing covers the dining service only.
listings.when: Serving breakfast and lunch daily from 8:30 AM to 1:00 PM.
listings.where: The provider page does not state a street address.

listings.offer: Shower program for guests. Warm showers, clean towels, toiletries, and new socks, underwear, and t shirts are provided to guests.
listings.when: The provider page does not publish hours for the shower program.
listings.where: The provider page does not state a street address.

listings.offer: Emergency shelter for adults, with case management, assessment, transportation, and life skills training. Free medical services are offered on site through a partner health center, as are psychiatric and substance abuse assessment services. To obtain a bed, contact the Coordinated Access Network by dialing 211.
listings.provider: Prospect House, Recovery Network of Programs
listings.when: The page says the shelter is available on a daily basis and does not publish hours.

listings.offer: Safe housing. Residents have a refuge from the streets, three meals a day, showers, healthcare, and support services, with case managers who help with goals and community resources. The provider page for its housing programs says its residential housing serves men, women, and mothers with children, and lists a track for mothers with children. For information the get help page lists 203-333-4087 for men and 203-333-9143 for women.
listings.when: The provider page does not publish hours for safe housing.
listings.where: The get help page does not state a street address for safe housing. It gives the address 725 Park Ave, Bridgeport, CT for hot meals and for groceries.

listings.offer: Free and confidential services for victims and survivors of domestic violence, sexual violence, human trafficking, and child abuse. Services listed include individual counseling for adult, youth and child victims, safety planning, support groups, support for parents, court advocacy, and safe emergency shelter. A 24/7 hotline is listed at 1-888-774-2900.
listings.when: Main office Monday to Friday from 9AM to 5PM, with walk ins available 9AM to 4PM. The domestic violence hotline is 24/7.

listings.offer: Same day care and walk in clinic for non life threatening illness or injury. Walk ins are welcome and no appointment or referral is needed on the page. Sliding fee options are listed, and major insurance, HUSKY and CT Medicaid, Medicare, and self pay patients are listed as accepted.
listings.when: The page says the clinic is open 7 days a week and accepts walk in patients 7 days a week. It does not publish daily clinic hours. X ray hours on the page are Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday from 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM.

listings.offer: Health services at this location are listed as adult medicine, Ryan White and HIV services, and podiatry.
